recipe.name: Ogiva / Delft clay / Silver 925
recipe.calibration_note: Starting shrink allowance; confirm with the caster's alloy, sand and measured trials.

manufacturing.bench_notes: Pour in two-part Delft clay with the parting on the keel (z = 0), pulling along the finger. Gate at the palm's keel, where no crocket stands. Break the flash along the keel with a fine file, keeping the crease sharp; polish the flanks and the crockets' faces; leave the niche floors as cast, or satin them.

features.name: Draw the pointed-arch section on the plane through the finger
Revolve the arch round the finger
Loft the gable over the hand through its pointed sections, rising to the ogive
Lay the parting plane just under the keel
Draw the crest moulding up the gable's right slope on the parting plane
Raise the cope half of the crest along the pull
Mirror the crest into the drag half
Join the halves of the crest
Draw the crockets climbing the right slope, and half the finial, on the parting plane
Raise the cope half of the crockets along the pull
Mirror the crockets into the drag half
Join the halves of the crockets
Set the crockets on the crest
Mirror the climb across the crown onto the left slope
Join both climbs and close the finial
Lay a plane over the cope foot
Draw one lancet niche on the foot plane
Sink the niche along the pull
Array the niches round the cope foot, clear of the gable
Mirror the niches into the drag foot
Lay a plane over the whole cope half
Draw the three lancet lights in the gable
Pierce the lights down to the parting plane
Mirror the lights up from the drag side
Cut the cope foot's niches
Cut the first niche
Cut the drag foot's niches
Raise the gable on the band
Join the crest, the crockets and the finial to the gable
Pierce the cope half of the lights
Pierce the drag half of the lights
